title: Settlement Basis for the Charge Withheld on a Car Rental Given Up
content:
When a renter gives up a rental, the charge withheld is worked out on the money already settled in advance
on that rental and on the notice the supplier was given, and is withheld from that money rather than billed
separately. This is the settlement basis applied across the Car Rental Rate Classes.

## The quantities

1. **The money settled in advance.** The money settled in advance on a rental is the total of the advance
   payments taken on it; each such payment is taken to cover the rental days booked, the optional items
   bought in advance and the rate class's agency service fee, and the ledger records both the payment and
   the separate lines for the items that payment covers.
2. **The notice.** The whole days of notice are the calendar days from the date the renter gave the rental
   up to the date of the scheduled collection.

## The charge

3. The basis the share acts on is the whole of the money settled in advance on the rental.
4. The share of the basis that the notice band sets is 80 per cent.
5. No relief is given against the share.
6. The reduced share is then taken at the rental's own value multiple, which is one.
7. Nothing is added for the time the supplier held the vehicle.
8. The figure is rounded to two decimal places once, on the final figure, and the share taken at the value
   multiple and the amount added for the time the vehicle was held are added together before that rounding.

The order of clauses 3 to 8 is the order in which the quantity is built: the basis first, the share of it
next, then the relief against that share, then the multiple on what the relief leaves, and last the amount
added for the time the vehicle was held, which joins the figure only before the single rounding.

## Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical rental on which 500 USD of advance payments stand on the ledger, given up 9 calendar
days before the scheduled collection date.

- The basis is the whole of the money settled in advance, which is 500 USD.
- The share of that basis is 80 per cent of 500 USD, which is 400 USD.
- No relief is given, so the figure stays at 400 USD.
- The value multiple is one, so the figure stays at 400 USD.
- Nothing is added for the time the vehicle was held, so nothing joins it.
- Rounded once on the final figure, the charge withheld is 400.00 USD, and it is withheld from the 500 USD
  already settled rather than billed to the renter again.
